english: The 3rd interim presentation for the Graduation Project will be held on 5 Nov (Thu).
Announcements and your assigned module have been sent to the email address you wrote on the submitted 면담확인서 (meeting confirmation form). Please check that email.
If you did not receive the email announcement, please make sure to tell the staff member in charge (김수진 (Kim Su-jin), ksj2602@snu.ac.kr).
If you wrote a Naver email account (or a similar non-SNU account) and want to change your address to your SNU account, please say so by email.
Attendance will be checked exactly on the hour, so please be careful not to be late or absent without permission.
(If you cannot attend for a reason such as reserve forces (예비군) training or an academic conference, please tell the staff member in charge in advance. Notice on the day itself is not accepted.)
